source_title: Polypipe Group plc Annual Report and Accounts 2019
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 112 and 146 state that the financial statements were approved for issue by the Board on 17 March 2020; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Despite difficult construction markets, revenue rose 3.3%, underlying operating profit 5.5%, profit before tax 3.3% and underlying margin by 30 basis points to 17.4%. Operating cash generation increased, leverage remained 1.7x and the Group retained a strong balance sheet. Acquisitions and a new organisational structure were already integrated or implemented.
already_announced_exclusion: The organisational restructure, divisional changes, Alderburgh integration and the completed Manthorpe and Permavoid integrations were public or completed before cutoff and are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: External market pressure is outweighed by revenue, profit, margin and cash growth with stable leverage and a strong balance sheet.

source_title: Genuit Group plc Annual Report and Accounts 2021
availability_evidence: Annual report page 132 states that the consolidated financial statements were approved for issue by the Board on 15 March 2022; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue rose 49.1%, underlying operating profit 125.8% and profit before tax 164.3%, with ongoing margin recovery despite raw-material cost and supply-chain constraints. Net debt increased after three acquisitions but leverage was only 1.2x pro-forma EBITDA, supported by a £96.3m equity raise and strong operational cash management.
already_announced_exclusion: The Adey, Nu-Heat and Plura integrations, capital raise and operational responses to supply and cost constraints disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Cost and supply pressure is specific but overwhelmed by exceptional revenue and earnings growth, recovering margins, low leverage and strong funding.

source_title: Genuit Group plc Annual Report and Accounts 2023
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 162 and 194 state that the financial statements were approved for issue by the Board on 12 March 2024; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Construction-market headwinds drove a 12.4% volume decline, revenue fell 5.7% and underlying operating profit 4.2%. However, underlying operating margin improved 20 basis points to 16.0%, profit before tax rose 6.6%, cash conversion increased to 87.7% and net debt fell 10.2%, with £247m liquidity headroom. Business simplification and lean-transformation projects were already underway.
already_announced_exclusion: Business simplification, Genuit Business System lean transformation, price and cost management and the internal Group restructuring disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: The severe volume contraction and lower revenue create material pressure, but protected margin, higher statutory profit, sharply improved cash conversion, deleveraging and ample liquidity are strong offsets.
